about: Road routes from each building to its nearby metro stations, BEST bus stops (walking, OSRM foot profile) and suburban railway stations (by road, OSRM car profile). Fetched from the FOSSGIS OSRM servers at routing.openstreetmap.de (OpenStreetMap data) on 2 Nov 2026; each route keeps the request it came from. Distances in metres along the route; sec is the router travel time (walking speed for foot; free-flow for car, so not used as a time). The two Marwah buildings (added Nov 2026) were routed with scripts/examples/overture-route.py on Overture Maps streets instead, as the OSRM servers could not be reached; their src says so.

corporate-avenue.note: Routes start on Guru Hargovindji Road in front of the building: the place-page pin sits about 100 m behind the frontage, and routing from it went round the block.

fulcrum.note: Fulcrum was re-pinned to the place page for The Empire Business Centre, A Wing, Fulcrum (19.104032, 72.872132), beside the Hyatt Regency; routes were fetched again from there.

marwah-tower.note: Routes start on Krishanlal Marwah Marg in front of Marwah Centre: from the address point they snapped to a loop road inside the campus. Computed on Overture Maps streets (the OSRM servers could not be reached, Nov 2026).

marwah-business-park.note: Routes start on Krishanlal Marwah Marg, Marwah Estate. Computed on Overture Maps streets (the OSRM servers could not be reached, Nov 2026).
